issues.description: Default for `delimiter` in overload signatures should be `...` not `None`
issues.detail: In typing overloads, keyword arguments should use `= ...` as the placeholder, not `= None`. Using `None` as the default in the overload stubs (lines 1955, 1966, 1978, etc.) is inconsistent with the surrounding `StoreArg = ...` style and may confuse type checkers about which overload to select. The implementation signature is the only place the real default belongs.

issues.description: `delimiter` arg silently ignored when value is already a list
issues.detail: When the same param appears multiple times or `auto_parse_qs_csv` already split it, `items` is a list and the delimiter is silently ignored. The test `test_get_param_as_list_parse_qs_csv_vs_delimiter` even asserts this surprising behavior. A user passing `delimiter='pipeDelimited'` reasonably expects splitting; silent no-op without warning is footgun-prone. Consider documenting more prominently or applying per-element.

issues.description: ValueError on unsupported delimiter bypasses HTTPBadRequest contract
issues.detail: The docstring states `HTTPBadRequest` is raised when transforms raise `ValueError`. Here, raising raw `ValueError` from `get_param_as_list` due to a programming error (bad `delimiter` value) propagates as a 500 to the client rather than being a clearly-labeled developer error. Consider raising `TypeError` or a Falcon-specific configuration error to distinguish from request-data errors.

Mapping `','` to `','`, `'|'` to `'|'`, `' '` to `' '` is redundant; a set for validation plus the named aliases would be clearer. Minor readability nit but signals the lookup table is doing two jobs (validation + alias resolution).

issues.description: Missing test for `keep_blank_qs_values` interaction with delimiter
issues.detail: The docstring explicitly states `keep_blank_qs_values` has no effect on secondary splitting by `delimiter`. There is no test asserting that behavior, e.g., `names=a,,b` with `delimiter=','` — does it yield `['a', '', 'b']` or `['a', 'b']`? Current `str.split` keeps the empty string, which may surprise users.

issues.description: No test for `delimiter` combined with `transform` callable
issues.detail: `get_param_as_list` supports a `transform` callable applied to each element. No test verifies that elements split via `delimiter` are passed through `transform`, nor that a `ValueError` from transform on a split element produces an `HTTPBadRequest`. Worth one parametrized test to lock in the contract.

review.summary: The PR cleanly adds a `delimiter` kwarg to `get_param_as_list` with reasonable coverage. Main concerns: overload type stubs use `= None` instead of `= ...` which can confuse type checkers; raw `ValueError` for unsupported delimiters will surface as 500s rather than a developer-facing error; and the silent no-op when `items` is already a list deserves clearer signaling. Test coverage is good but misses `transform` interaction and blank-segment behavior.
